acceptance_gates.name: Source integration
acceptance_gates.criterion: Minimal imported WorldData optimized reader+SQLite changes; same refresh interface and source hashes; REA/WorldData tests pass

acceptance_gates.name: Save/worldline isolation
acceptance_gates.criterion: Restored old save with backward game date and fresh save each produce distinct bound history without deleting old facts

acceptance_gates.name: Human CLI protocol
acceptance_gates.criterion: Each command triggers only documented operation, produces status/receipt without asking to re-enter PID

acceptance_gates.name: Capture chronology
acceptance_gates.criterion: Initial FULL, weekly INCREMENTAL, post-mutation TARGETED_READBACK, event capture and annual skip all preserve provenance

acceptance_gates.name: Role authorization
acceptance_gates.criterion: Trusted host supplies role profiles/phase grants; proposed decisions cannot self-authenticate or grant write scope

acceptance_gates.name: Sealed plan and CAS
acceptance_gates.criterion: Digest+live Getter+game epoch binding, mismatch fail closed; no implicit partial execution

acceptance_gates.name: Strict live receipt bridge
acceptance_gates.criterion: Raw messages, chunk identity/digest, per-item outcome, journal and independent readback required before outbox success feedback

acceptance_gates.name: Four offline cycles
acceptance_gates.criterion: 4 7-day transitions, one NO_CHANGE, conflicting role intents, partial/unknown, restart/retry tests; no real game writes

acceptance_gates.name: Four Human-triggered live cycles
acceptance_gates.criterion: Only after user prompts; separate live evidence and game effects, manual sim, no unsupported writer

acceptance_gates.name: Season-scale run
acceptance_gates.criterion: Human may extend after pilot; 20-40 observation cadence; per-cycle ledger and event checkpoints; stop and resume safe

must_not: Infer game date/PID from old logs
Merge diverged old task branches into master by default
game_state_execution_scope: Initial offline engineering only. Human will trigger actual live cycles separately; no automatic real gameplay testing in new task without current context.
